rule: Next-minute call, only the top 2% most confident minutes (cutoff set on 2022-24 validation)

best_case.label: Best case: fills at the signal bar's exact close, 0.3 bps cost

caveats: The best case needs a fill at the closing price of the bar that triggered the signal, which is not achievable in practice.
The 2% slice was chosen from a 1-10% sweep and the test period was looked at several times, so the figures are somewhat optimistic.
A one-minute delay removes almost all of the edge (+0.03 bps per trade before costs).
